_meta.purpose: Module 2 (WSD) aspect/sense taxonomy for the Dravidian (Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada) code-mixed domain.
_meta.derivation: Frequency analysis of candidate English-loanword keyword groups over the 'text' column of tamil_sentiment_train_preprocessed.csv, mal_sentiment_train_preprocessed.csv, kannada_sentiment_train_preprocessed.csv (53,263 rows total). This domain is YouTube-comment movie/celebrity sentiment, not a product-review domain -- categories below were selected because they actually recur in this data, not because they are typical WSD/aspect examples elsewhere.
_meta.method: For each candidate category, counted rows whose lowercased text contains any of its keyword variants (regex substring match). Categories below 1.0% of rows were dropped as not genuinely recurring.
_meta.not_used: The task prompt's example categories (Battery, Camera, Display, Price, Performance, Build Quality) are electronics/product-review aspects. They do not occur in this project's Dravidian data (movie/entertainment YouTube comments) and were not used -- this taxonomy is derived from the actual corpus instead.

categories.name: Fan / Stardom
categories.definition: Commentary about an actor's or star's fan following, fan base, mass appeal, or hype -- not about the film's content itself.

categories.name: Trailer / Teaser
categories.definition: Reactions to a film's promotional trailer, teaser, or promo video, as distinct from reactions to the finished film.

categories.name: Music / BGM
categories.definition: Opinions about a film's songs, background score (BGM), or music in general.

categories.name: Box Office / Collection
categories.definition: Commentary on a film's commercial performance -- collections, hit/flop status, box-office numbers.

categories.name: Dialogue
categories.definition: Opinions about specific dialogue lines, dialogue delivery, or 'punch' dialogues.

categories.name: Story / Screenplay
categories.definition: Opinions about the film's story, plot, or screenplay/script.

categories.name: Hero / Character
categories.definition: Opinions about a lead hero, heroine, villain, or other named character/casting choice.
